well_evidenced.label: Well-Evidenced
well_evidenced.definition: Supported by randomized controlled trials (RCTs) or systematic reviews

promising.label: Promising
promising.definition: Supported by observational studies, case series, or expert consensus without RCT confirmation
promising.patient_language: Early research looks encouraging, but more studies are needed

emerging.label: Emerging / Complementary
emerging.definition: Limited formal research; primarily patient-reported or traditional medicine
emerging.patient_language: Limited research so far, but some women report benefit
